newsitem.title: UK: Yeoman placing price set at 175 pence per share.
newsitem.headline: Yeoman placing price set at 175 pence per share.

text.p: Yeoman Group Plc said it is placing 2.14 million shares with institutional and other investors at 175 pence per share to raise 3.75 million stg.

The placing price gives Yeoman a market capitalisation of 8.8 million stg. Yeoman develops and sells devices to enable users to pinpoint their exact position on conventional paper maps using the U.S. government Global Positioning System.
Dealings in Yeoman shares on the Alternative Investment Market are expected to start on December 11.
